category.description: The name of the category in the default language of the webshop. Not applicable for product variations.

description:lang.description: Product description. Same languages as name.

image:no.description: Include an image URL to upload product photos. The first image is the main photo, the next four are sub photos. When a product photo already exists, it will be replaced. After uploading, the images will be scaled proportionally according to the webshop settings, thumbnails will be created automatically and the image will be synchronized to multiple file servers. Make sure that each image has a valid URL, a maximum file size of 25MB, a valid extension (.jpg, .jpeg, .png or .gif) and a valid MIME type (image/jpeg, image/jpg, image/png, image/gif).

name:lang.description: Product name. You can set names and descriptions for all languages, even if they are not activated in the webshop. Available languages (ISO 639-1): cs, da, de, el, en, es, fi, fr, it, ja, ko, nl, no, pl, pt, ro, ru, sv, tr, zh.

price.description: Can be decimal, integer, empty or a string.

productID.description: A unique and user defined identifier for the product.

status.description: Accepted values: Available, Available but not online, Pre-order, Sold Out, Invisible, Customers only, Price visible for customers, Choose property, Hide status, custom0, custom1, ..., custom9.

stock.description: Set to 0 for infinite stock or disabled stock.
